bai: Bai 04 nhom ham dem COUNT COUNTA COUNTBLANK COUNTIF COUNTIFS

cau_hoi.A: =COUNT(value1, ...) dem cac o chua so
cau_hoi.cau: Ham COUNT dung de lam gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: COUNT chi dem o chua so, bo qua text, o rong.

cau_hoi.A: Khong dem duoc
cau_hoi.B: =COUNTA(value1, ...) dem tat ca o chua ky tu (so, chu, dau cach)
cau_hoi.cau: Ham COUNTA dung de lam gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: COUNTA dem moi o co ky tu.

cau_hoi.A: =COUNTBLANK(range) dem o rong
cau_hoi.cau: Ham COUNTBLANK dung de lam gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: COUNTBLANK dem o rong.

cau_hoi.A: =COUNTIF dem co dieu kien
cau_hoi.cau: Ham COUNTIF khac gi COUNT?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: COUNTIF dem co 1 dieu kien.

cau_hoi.A: =COUNTIFS dem nhieu dieu kien, lap lai cap vung/dieu kien
cau_hoi.cau: Ham COUNTIFS dung khi nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Khi co tu 2 dieu kien tro len.

cau_hoi.A: Cu phap COUNTIF va COUNTIFS giong nhau, chi them cap vung/dieu kien
cau_hoi.cau: So sanh cu phap COUNTIF/COUNTIFS voi SUMIF/SUMIFS?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: COUNTIF/COUNTIFS giong nhau; khac SUMIF/SUMIFS (SUM doi vi tri vung tong).

cau_hoi.A: =COUNT(B2:E8) = 24 o chua so
cau_hoi.cau: Vi du COUNT trong video cho ket qua bao nhieu?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: 24 o chua so; 32 la COUNTA, 3 la COUNTBLANK.

cau_hoi.A: =COUNTA(B2:E8) = 32 o co ky tu
cau_hoi.cau: Vi du COUNTA trong video cho ket qua bao nhieu?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: 32 o co ky tu tren tong 35 o.

cau_hoi.A: =COUNTBLANK = 32
cau_hoi.cau: Vi du COUNTBLANK trong video?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: = 3 o rong; 32+3=35 tong so o.

cau_hoi.A: Tong o = 35 (7 cot x 5 hang); 32 co ky tu + 3 rong
cau_hoi.cau: Vung du lieu B2:E8 co bao nhieu o?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: 35 o: 32 co ky tu, 3 rong.

cau_hoi.A: O chua so 8 nam sat ben phai; o chuoi nam ben trai
cau_hoi.cau: Phan biet so that va chuoi gia so?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: So that can phai, text can trai.

cau_hoi.A: Go them text vao o rong thi COUNTA tang, COUNTBLANK giam; go so thi COUNT tang
cau_hoi.cau: Thi nghiem go Excel vao o rong thi cac ham doi the nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: COUNTA tang, COUNTBLANK giam; so thi COUNT tang.

cau_hoi.A: =COUNTIF(range, "con*") dem o bat dau bang con
cau_hoi.cau: Dem o bat dau bang chu con viet the nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dung wildcard *: con*.

cau_hoi.A: Vi =COUNTIF(range, "con") so sanh khop hoan toan nen = 0
cau_hoi.cau: Tai sao =COUNTIF(vung, "con") tra ve 0?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Vi no doi khop dung chu con, trong khi du lieu la con an, computer...

cau_hoi.A: Them * sau con de dai dien moi chuoi sau no
cau_hoi.cau: Y nghia dau * trong con*?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dai dien bat ky chuoi nao sau con.

cau_hoi.A: "*con" dem o ket thuc bang con
cau_hoi.cau: Neu muon dem o ket thuc bang con thi viet the nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: * dung truoc de dai dien phan dau.

cau_hoi.A: "*con*" dem o chua con o bat ky vi tri
cau_hoi.cau: Muon dem o chua chu con o giua thi viet the nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Them * ca truoc va sau.

cau_hoi.A: Ket qua con* = 3 (con an, con ...)
cau_hoi.cau: Ket qua dem bat dau bang con trong video?

cau_hoi.A: Them t truoc con thanh tcon* thi ket qua giam con 1-2
cau_hoi.cau: Thi nghiem them chu t truoc con thi sao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ket qua giam vi it o khop hon.

cau_hoi.A: Xoa chu t di de ve dung yeu cau bai toan
cau_hoi.cau: Sau thi nghiem thi lam gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Xoa chu t de ve con* = 3.

cau_hoi.A: =COUNTIFS(vung, ">50", vung, "<60") = 5 o
cau_hoi.cau: Dem o lon hon 50 va nho hon 60 viet the nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: 2 cap vung/dieu kien, dieu kien trong ngoac kep.

cau_hoi.cau: Kiem tra 5 o >50 va <60 la nhung so nao?

cau_hoi.A: Chi can them s: COUNTIF thanh COUNTIFS, giu nguyen cu phap
cau_hoi.cau: Cach chuyen COUNTIF sang COUNTIFS?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Them s va them cap vung/dieu kien.

cau_hoi.A: Bai tap tinh tong theo san pham + khu vuc: =SUMIFS(vung tong, vung SP, SP, vung KV, KV) co dinh $ va F4
cau_hoi.cau: Bai tap bai 3 duoc giai dau bai 4 la gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: SUMIFS 2 dieu kien SP + KV, co dinh.

cau_hoi.A: O G14 (SP) va F4 co dinh vi copy xuong van giu dieu kien
cau_hoi.cau: Tai sao o dieu kien G14/F4 phai F4?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: De copy xuong khong dich.

cau_hoi.A: 3 dieu kien: khu vuc + san pham + doanh thu >800000, vung DT vua la vung tong vua la vung dieu kien
cau_hoi.cau: Vi du SUMIFS 3 dieu kien duoc giai the nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Them cap (vung DT, >800000).

cau_hoi.A: Doi mien Trung/Nam hoac SP02 thi ket qua tu doi; SP02 khong co DT >800000 nen = 0
cau_hoi.cau: Cach kiem tra cong thuc 3 dieu kien?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Doi dieu kien xem ket qua co doi khong.

cau_hoi.A: Tinh diem trung binh moi thi sinh roi dung COUNTIF/COUNTIFS dem theo moc 5, 6, 8
cau_hoi.cau: Bai tap ve nha cua bai 4 la gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tinh DTB roi dem so thi sinh dau/rot, DTB >=8.

cau_hoi.A: DTB >= 5 hoac >= 6 la dau, duoi la rot tuy de bai
cau_hoi.cau: Moc diem dau/rot trong bai tap?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: DTB lon bang 5/6 la dau, duoi la rot.

cau_hoi.A: DTB > 8 la xuat sac can dem rieng
cau_hoi.cau: Moc DTB lon hon 8 de lam gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dem so thi sinh gioi.

cau_hoi.A: Go =COUNT roi Tab hoac double-click de chon nhanh ham dau tien
cau_hoi.cau: Meo nhap nhanh ham COUNT?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Go COUNT roi Tab.

cau_hoi.A: Boi den toan vung B2:E8 roi dong ngoac Enter
cau_hoi.cau: Cach chon vung cho ham dem?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Boi den vung du lieu.

cau_hoi.A: Dieu kien chu dat trong ngoac kep, dieu kien so sanh nhu >50 cung trong ngoac kep
cau_hoi.cau: Dieu kien trong COUNTIF viet the nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dat trong ngoac kep.

cau_hoi.A: O trong duoc hieu la khong co gi, COUNTBLANK dem no
cau_hoi.cau: O rong duoc hieu the nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: La o khong co gi.

cau_hoi.A: Dau cach cung la ky tu nen COUNTA van dem
cau_hoi.cau: O chi chua dau cach thi COUNTA co dem khong?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Co, vi dau cach la ky tu.

cau_hoi.A: So 14, 28 duoc COUNT dem; chuoi va o trong khong dem
cau_hoi.cau: Vi du so 14, 28 trong vung thi COUNT xu ly sao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: So thi dem, chuoi/rong bo qua.

cau_hoi.A: Nen nho dang ky kenh va chia se de ung ho
cau_hoi.cau: Cuoi video giang vien nhan manh gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dang ky kenh va chia se.

cau_hoi.A: File thuc hanh va cau hoi o duoi video, ai khong biet tai thi xem bai mo dau
cau_hoi.cau: Lay file thuc hanh bai 4 o dau?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: O duoi video; xem bai mo dau neu chua biet tai.

cau_hoi.A: Bai 4 day 5 ham dem kem wildcard * va dieu kien so sanh
cau_hoi.cau: Tom tat bai 4 da hoc gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: COUNT, COUNTA, COUNTBLANK, COUNTIF, COUNTIFS.

cau_hoi.A: Bai tiep theo la bai 5 ve ham dieu kien
cau_hoi.D: Bai tiep theo on lai bai 4 va hoc ham moi theo lo trinh 26 video
cau_hoi.cau: Sau bai 4 se hoc gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tiep tuc lo trinh cac ham quan trong.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Dem cac o chua so, bo qua text, o rong.
Dem tat ca o chua ky tu (so, chu, dau cach).
Dem 1 dieu kien. criteria trong ngoac kep; dung * de khop tung phan.
Dem nhieu dieu kien, lap lai cap vung/dieu kien. Cu phap giong COUNTIF.
Wildcard * dai dien moi chuoi; dieu kien so sanh dat trong ngoac kep.
cong_thuc.ten: Wildcard va dieu kien so sanh
cong_thuc.vi_du: con* bat dau bang con; *con ket thuc bang con; *con* chua con

cong_thuc.cu_phap: =SUMIFS(sum_range, criteria_range1, criteria1, ...); F4 co dinh vung va o dieu kien; dieu kien so trong ngoac kep
cong_thuc.giai_thich: On tap bai 3: tinh tong theo san pham + khu vuc, mo rong 3 dieu kien them cap (vung DT, lon hon 800000); doi dieu kien de kiem tra.
cong_thuc.vi_du: =SUMIFS(DT,KV,F16,SP,G14); them (DT, lon hon 800000); SP02 khong co DT lon hon 800000 nen = 0

cong_thuc.cu_phap: =AVERAGE(number1, ...) tinh trung binh; ket hop COUNTIF/COUNTIFS dem theo moc diem
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Bai tap ve nha: tinh DTB moi thi sinh roi dem so dau (DTB lon bang 5 hoac 6), rot, va DTB lon hon 8.
cong_thuc.vi_du: =AVERAGE(B2:D2) ra DTB; =COUNTIF(DTB, lon bang 6) dem so dau

cong_thuc.cu_phap: Go COUNT roi Tab/double-click de chon ham; boi den vung roi Enter; F4 co dinh; doi gia tri dieu kien de kiem tra
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Meo Tab chon nhanh ham; co dinh o dieu kien (G14) de copy khong dich; doi mien/SP xem ket qua co doi khong.
cong_thuc.ten: Nhap nhanh va kiem tra cong thuc
cong_thuc.vi_du: Go COUNT Tab > boi den B2:E8 Enter; doi Bac thanh Trung de kiem tra

thuat_toan_quy_trinh: Buoc 1: Giai bai tap bai 3: dung SUMIFS cho 2 dieu kien san pham + khu vuc, F4 co dinh vung va o dieu kien; mo rong 3 dieu kien them cap (vung DT, lon hon 800000).
Buoc 2: Dung COUNT de dem o so, COUNTA dem o co ky tu, COUNTBLANK dem o rong tren vung B2:E8 (24/32/3).
Buoc 3: Thi nghiem go text/so vao o rong de thay COUNTA tang, COUNTBLANK giam, COUNT tang khi go so.
Buoc 4: Dung COUNTIF 1 dieu kien chuoi: con* de dem bat dau bang con (=3); giai thich vi sao con khong co * thi =0.
Buoc 5: Dung COUNTIFS nhieu dieu kien so: lon hon 50 va nho hon 60 (=5); mo rong tu COUNTIF chi can them s.
Buoc 6: Lam bai tap ve nha: tinh diem trung binh roi dung COUNTIF/COUNTIFS dem so dau (lon bang 5/6), rot, va DTB lon hon 8.
